title: Microsoft Edge: Notifications unsubscribe user action
description: Microsoft Edge adds an Unsubscribe button to eligible website push notifications, allowing users to stop receiving notifications from a website directly from the notification, without opening browser settings. Administrators can continue to manage website notification permissions through existing enterprise policies.
